app.name: BorrowBox
app.tagline: Borrow what you need from your neighbours

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back! Sign in to continue.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Join your neighbours and start borrowing in a minute.
register.passwordHint: 8–64 characters, with at least one letter and one digit

export.title: Download your data
export.description: Get a copy of the personal data BorrowBox holds about you, as a JSON file.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.description: Your personal data will be erased. Records we must keep by law (e.g. payments) are anonymised. This cannot be undone.

deleteDialog.title: Delete your account?
deleteDialog.body: This permanently deletes your account and signs you out everywhere.
deleteDialog.noPassword: For your security, you need to have signed in within the last 5 minutes.

validation.password: 8–64 characters, with at least one letter and one digit
validation.euros: Enter an amount, e.g. 5.50 (no thousands separators)

errors.MALFORMED_REQUEST: Something went wrong with the request. Please try again.
errors.INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this email already exists.
errors.OAUTH_EXCHANGE_FAILED: Google sign-in didn't work. Please try again.
errors.OAUTH_EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Your Google account's email isn't verified.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: BorrowBox is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.NETWORK: Can't reach BorrowBox. Check your connection.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This item doesn’t exist or is no longer available.
errors.INVALID_STATE: That can’t be done right now. Please refresh the page and try again.
errors.NOT_PUBLISHABLE: To publish, an item needs a location and at least one photo.
errors.ITEM_LIMIT_REACHED: You’ve reached the item limit. Delete one to add another.
errors.PHOTO_LIMIT_REACHED: You’ve reached the photo limit for this item.

map.unavailable: The map isn’t available right now.

errors.denied: Location access was denied. You can allow it in your browser’s settings.
errors.unavailable: Your location couldn’t be found. Move the map instead.
errors.timeout: Finding your location took too long. Please try again.

explore.emptyHint: Try a larger distance or fewer filters.

lend.title: Lend your things
lend.text: Earn a little from things you rarely use. Listing one takes a few minutes.

find.title: Find it nearby
find.text: Search what your neighbours lend and see roughly where it is.

pay.title: Pay safely
pay.text: Pay through BorrowBox. The deposit comes back after the return.

handoff.title: Hand over with a QR code
handoff.text: Scan a code at pickup and at return, so you both confirm.

item.areaHint: The exact spot is shared only once a booking is paid.
item.depositHint: Charged with the rent and refunded when the item comes back.

listing.title: Title
listing.descriptionHint: Condition, what's included, how pickup works.
listing.ratesIntro: Fill in the rates you want to offer (at least one).
listing.noRate: Add at least one rate, or lend it for free.
listing.locationIntro: Put the pin where the item is picked up: tap the map or drag the pin.
listing.dropPin: Tap the map to place the pin.
listing.locationPrivacy: Others only see an area of about 300 m around it, never the exact spot.
listing.photosIntro: Up to {{max}} photos, 10 MB each. The first one is the cover.
listing.photosSkipped: {{count}} photos weren't added: up to {{max}} per item.
listing.dragToReorder: Drag the photos to change their order.

photoErrors.unsupported: This file type isn't supported here. Try JPEG or PNG.
photoErrors.tooSmall: Photo too small (at least 320 px wide).

listing.publishIntro: Once published, the item shows up in search.
listing.isActive: This item is published. Changes apply right away.
listing.isPaused: This item is paused and doesn't show up in search.
listing.leaveUnsaved: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page?
listing.photoNeeded: Add at least one photo to continue: items are listed with a photo.

myItems.emptyHint: Lend the things you rarely use to your neighbours.
myItems.deleteMessage: “{{title}}” and its photos will be deleted for good.
